description: On the yellow tabletop there’s a pile of multicolored beads in the center, a tape dispenser to the upper right, and a red string lying across the surface. The left hand steadies the red string near the bottom center while the right hand moves rightward and then up to the bead pile to pick up a bead, brings it back down to the string, and uses both hands together as a two-hand object to guide the bead onto the string and slide it along before the right hand reaches back toward the pile for another bead.
